Question 5
?

Given that f(x,y)=x+yy, find the set of values (x,y) on which ∂f∂y exists.

a
{(x,y):y≠0andx≠0}
b
{(x,y):x+y>0}
c
{(x,y):y≠0andx+y>0}
d
{(x,y):y≠0andx+y≥0}
e
fy exists everywhere on the xy-plane
